title: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.56.7212 does not perform authorization or CSRF checks on…
description: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin versions before 7.5.56.7212 lack authorization and CSRF checks on certain cloud storage media browser handlers. This flaw allows any authenticated user, even with minimal permissions like Subscriber, to access configuration details and file listings of the site's connected cloud storage accounts.
